headlines.description: Quarterback Brandon Weeden replaced injured starter Brian Hoyer and rallied the Cleveland Browns to a 37-24 win Thursday night over the Buffalo Bills, who also lost starting rookie quarterback EJ Manuel with a knee injury.
headlines.shortLinkText: Browns rally past Bills; QBs Hoyer, Manuel hurt

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: Drew Brees threw two touchdown passes to Pierre Thomas, Jimmy Graham tied an NFL record with another 100-yard game and the New Orleans Saints beat the Chicago Bears 26-18 on Sunday to remain unbeaten.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees, Saints beat Bears to improve to 5-0

events.name: New England Patriots at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: BenJarvus Green-Ellis ran 1 yard in the fourth quarter for the game's only touchdown, and the Cincinnati Bengals ended Tom Brady's long streak of touchdown passes on Sunday in a 13-6 victory over the previously unbeaten New England Patriots.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals halt Brady's TD streak, edge Pats

events.name: Detroit Lions at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: James Jones caught a long touchdown pass from Aaron Rodgers, and the Packers defense contained the undermanned Detroit Lions for a 22-9 win Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers extend Lambeau streak vs. Lions

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: Jamaal Charles scored a 1-yard touchdown with 6:23 left, and the Kansas City Chiefs kept up their perfect start after rallying to beat the Tennessee Titans 26-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs need rally vs. Titans to stay perfect

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw two touchdown passes and Donald Brown scored the go-ahead TD with 8:55 to go to lead the Indianapolis Colts past the Seattle Seahawks 34-28 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck, Colts rally to hand Seahawks 1st loss

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Sam Bradford threw three touchdown passes and Matt Giordano's 82-yard interception return was one of several big plays from the St. Louis Rams' defense in a 34-20 victory Sunday that kept the Jacksonville Jaguars winless.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams drop Jaguars to 0-5 behind Bradford

headlines.description: Justin Tucker kicked a 44-yard field goal to put the Baltimore Ravens ahead with 1:42 left, and they withstood a frantic comeback bid by the Miami Dolphins to win 26-23 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens fight off Dolphins' comeback attempt

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New York Giants

headlines.description: Nick Foles threw for two touchdowns and led four scoring drives after taking over for an injured Michael Vick late in the second quarter, and the Philadelphia Eagles kept the New York Giants winless with a 36-21 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Foles replaces Vick as Eagles crush Giants
Cardinals harass Newton, beat up Panthers

headlines.description: Matt Prater kicked a 28-yard field goal as time expired and Peyton Manning and Denver overcame the first 500-yard passing game in Dallas history to keep the Broncos unbeaten with a 51-48 victory over the Cowboys on Sunday.

headlines.shortLinkText: Niners blitz Texans as Schaub gets benched

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Pryor, Woodson lead Raiders past Chargers 27-17
headlines.shortLinkText: Pryor, Woodson lead Raiders past Chargers 27-17

events.name: New York Jets at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Nick Folk kicked a 43-yard field goal on the final play of the game, and the New York Jets handed struggling Atlanta its third straight loss, beating the Falcons 30-28 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Smith's late drive pushes Jets over Falcons
